The number of I/O requests to keep in fl: The number of I/O requests to keep in flight at the same time. Higher values push the storage harder and reveal peak throughput, but may increase latency. Low values (1–4) simulate single-threaded applications; high values (32–128) simulate parallel workloads like databases.
The number of parallel FIO worker proces: The number of parallel FIO worker processes. Each job independently generates I/O against the storage. More jobs simulate more concurrent users or application threads. Typical values: 1 for single-thread baseline, 4–8 for moderate concurrency, 16+ for heavy parallel loads.
